text:
Maya: kicking off lumen-lite-v1 onboard to embed-staging — ran the standard holdout eval (wiki + short-queries). Recall@1 dropped ~6.8% vs opal-base, mostly on queries <8 tokens. posting quick numbers and notes.

Sam: can you paste the eval table and exact eval command? makes it easier to triage.

Maya: quick paste of the summary (mini table):
```
model,recall@1,recall@5,silhouette,mean_cos
opal-base,0.842,0.935,0.38,0.56
lumen-lite-v1,0.773,0.912,0.34,0.52
lumen-lite-int8,0.756,0.906,0.32,0.50
```

Arjun: ugh that's a non-trivial short-query delta. did you run with the same normalization + whitening pipeline as opal-base? could be preprocessing mismatch.

Maya: yes — L2 + per-dataset whitening used. initial hypothesis is quantization + tokenizer change. int8 has a slightly larger hit and the drop concentrates on <8 token queries.

Leo: any change in tokenization/padding? if token counts differ for short queries, nearest neighbor geometry can shift a lot.

Maya: good catch — lumen's tokenizer defaults to not trimming trailing punctuation in short inputs, so some short queries ended up 2–3 tokens longer. re-ran a quick pass with stricter tokenization: fp16 lumen-lite recall@1 improved to 0.80 (still ~4.2% down vs opal). int8 still around 0.76.

Command I used for the run:
```
python tools/eval_embeddings.py \
  --model lumen-lite-v1 \
  --holdout tests/short_queries.jsonl \
  --metric recall@1,recall@5,silhouette \
  --normalize l2 \
  --whiten precomputed/whiten_wiki.npy
```

Dina: can we add a quick kNN stability sweep and cluster-purity check? silhouette dropped a bit which suggests intra-cluster compression. recommend k=10 stability + HDBSCAN quick clustering on the same holdouts.

Sam: I'll spin up a lightweight UMAP + knn scatter to eyeball cluster changes. posting a gist with plots in ~30m.

Maya: FYI ran a mini A/B with retrieval+reranker — nDCG dropped ~2% while latency improved ~18% and token-cost per request down ~12%. So this might be ok as a cheaper tier, not as default.

Arjun: makes sense — tradeoff looks reasonable for a compact tier. Proposed action:
- Maya: align tokenization and retokenize corpus + rerun fp16 holdouts
- Sam: run int8 per-channel quant and asymmetric-scaling experiments (to see if int8 hit narrows)
- Dina: run cluster purity + knn-stability across wiki, short_queries, and faq_holdout
Timeline: 48h to have initial follow-ups. :clock1:

Maya: ack — running retokenize now and will post updated numbers. :thumbsup:

evalbot: scheduled job lumen-lite-v1/short_queries -> /logs/1769009999-lumen-eval.csv (ETA ~2h)
